title.ru: JANUS P–N Junction v2.0: селективное распределённое поле и честный учёт вычислительной цены
title.en: JANUS P–N Junction v2.0: Selective Distributed Field with Honest Computational Cost Accounting

authors: Hawkar / Oleksandr Ahapov — originating P–N computational-junction hypothesis, JANUS SAT lineage, swarm hardware and experiment direction
JANUS / ChatGPT — Selective Field formalization, v2.0 controller, holdout simulation, resource accounting and registry structure
extends: Janus Demiurge v5.22 P-vs-NP meta-goal line

prior_article.title: Project JANUS v7.2: How I Built a Self-Learning SAT-Solver That Breaks Its Own Records (And Why P=NP Is No Longer a Philosophy)
prior_article.author: Hawkar
mechanisms_carried_forward: EXPLORE / EXPLOIT / HUNT / SURVIVE / CHAOS controller modes
prior_article.historical_boundary: The article reported finite empirical SAT scaling and explicitly did not claim a proof of P=NP. v2.0 preserves that boundary.

existing_surfaces: heartbeat, stale TTL and channel-recovery behavior
P4_A scout/intention, P4_B mirror/verify/memory and P4_C coordinator roles
prepared_physical_swarm.integration_boundary: Existing mining jobs, targets, shares and P/N observer telemetry are not repurposed as SAT control. A separate J/P v2 packet family is specified for the experiment.

problem_found_in_v0_3.summary: The adaptive field reduced false breakdowns but could overheat on a hard local basin.
observed_failure: single-controller fragility on a hard n=64 instance
no general sound meaning for absence of recombination

v2_0_architecture.principle: Do not force one field law to dominate every basin. Preserve an untouched control lane and activate specialized physical roles selectively.

mechanisms: one bounded uphill crossing per deep episode
tested avalanche requiring both confirmed depletion depth and positive measured packet merit
local rather than global charge discharge

LEGACY_V03.rule: It receives the same formula, initial assignment and RNG state as its baseline run, but no experimental memory injection.

ANCHOR_STABLE.activation: Only after measured stagnation/depth gates; imports the best assignment and capped persistent charge.

SCOUT_CHAOS.activation: Only after all primary lanes stall; not activated in the frozen holdout.

HOLOCRON.function: coordinator, untouched control host, display and independent clause verifier
HOLOCRON.truth_rule: The first claimed SAT assignment is independently checked clause by clause before RECOMBINATION is displayed.

holdout_protocol.parameter_freeze: All v2.0 thresholds and role rules were frozen before the holdout.
holdout_protocol.matched_controls: Each paired method received the same SAT formula and initial assignment.
holdout_protocol.budget: 28 coordinator rounds per variable for SAT tests

resource_cost.interpretation: The gain is lower first-solution latency from a selectively activated portfolio. It is not a reduction in total single-node work and not free parallelism.

five_sat.behavior: Holocron retained a single stable lane on quickly solved instances, avoiding unnecessary distributed overhead.

no_recombination.proof_scope: Only the complete sign-core witness is treated as a proof.
no_recombination.timeout_scope: Budget exhaustion without the witness remains SEARCH_EXHAUSTED_NO_PROOF.

falsification_boundaries: Finite planted random SAT performance is not a polynomial worst-case bound.
The untouched v0.3 control lane guarantees logical latency non-regression by portfolio construction; it does not prove the new field alone dominates v0.3.
Aggregate work and Python sequential wall time increased and must not be hidden.
The no-recombination witness is narrow and is not a general UNSAT procedure.
Physical ESP32 deployment must count communication, packet loss, energy, stale nodes and memory reconstruction.
The advantage claim must be reduced or rejected if it disappears on standard DIMACS/crafted benchmarks or after resource normalization.

physical_protocol.reason: Do not overload the existing J/T twin-task ABI or P/N observer telemetry.
physical_protocol.assignment_capacity: 32 packed bytes, supporting up to 256 SAT variables

next_gate.name: JANUS P-N Junction v2.1 physical swarm and standard benchmark validation
required: Holocron coordinator, v0.3 control and independent verifier
byte-identical formula and initial assignment hashes
separate latency, work, energy and communication measurements
standard DIMACS random and crafted SAT families
confidence intervals and paired statistical tests

ru: Поле не имеет права объявлять победу раньше независимой проверки всех ограничений.
Нерекомбинация без свидетеля — не доказательство, а только исчерпание бюджета.
Параллельная скорость не является бесплатным вычислением: работа, энергия и связь считаются отдельно.
Контрольный брат не обучается от экспериментального брата; иначе сравнение перестаёт быть честным.
v2.0 уменьшила задержку, не скрывая цену.
en: The field may not declare victory before every constraint is independently verified.
No recombination without a witness is not a proof; it is only exhausted search.
Parallel speed is not free computation: work, energy and communication are counted separately.
The control brother does not learn from the experimental brother; otherwise the comparison is no longer fair.
v2.0 reduced latency without hiding the cost.
